# StarTap

> StarTap (https://startap.fun) is a geography trivia game about famous people. Each round shows a star from music, sport, screen or another world, with a short clue about a place in their story: where they grew up, trained or broke through. The player spins and zooms a 3D globe, taps where they think it happened and locks the answer; the closer the pin, the higher the score, up to 1,000 points a round and 5,000 for a five-round game. It plays in any modern web browser on phone, tablet or computer. There is no clock. Free play needs no account, and the site has no ads.

## Play
- [Today's Five](https://startap.fun/play/): the daily game, free for everyone. The same five stars for every player, from music, sport and screen; a new set starts every day at midnight UTC. Scored by distance.
- [World Mix](https://startap.fun/world-mix/): five stars drawn from across the worlds, no more than two from any one world. Two steps a round: the country (up to 300 points), then the city (up to 700 points).
- [Music World](https://startap.fun/category/music/): genres including Afrobeats, Amapiano, Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop / Rap, R&B, Reggae / Dancehall, Country, Latin, K-Pop, Electronic / DJ, African Music Legends, Global Music Icons and 80s/90s Soul Legends.
- [Sports World](https://startap.fun/category/sports/): Football / Soccer, Basketball, American Football, Baseball, Boxing, MMA / UFC, Tennis, Track & Field, Formula 1, Cricket, Gymnastics, Racket Sports and Winter Sports.
- More worlds: [Screen](https://startap.fun/category/screen/), [World Icons](https://startap.fun/category/icons/), [Tech & Innovation](https://startap.fun/category/tech/) and [More](https://startap.fun/category/more/) (Fashion & Beauty, Business & Money, Creators & Internet, Royalty & Dynasties).

## Rules
- [How to play](https://startap.fun/how-to-play/): see the star, read the clue, explore the globe, tap your guess, lock your answer, then see the real place, the distance and a short story. Another hint gives a second clue but costs 200 points that round; scores never go below zero.

## Help
- [Support](https://startap.fun/support/): free-play progress is saved in the browser on that device. Contact: sales@startap.fun.
- [Premium](https://startap.fun/premium/): an optional paid plan, currently sold only in Nigeria (NGN). Today's Five stays free.
- [Privacy](https://startap.fun/privacy/) and [Terms](https://startap.fun/terms/).

## Android
- An Android app is on its way to Google Play; it is not listed yet. The website and the app share the same game.
